infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: We need camera access so you can record a video affirmation (the 'Future Self' feature) where you speak as if you have already achieved your dreams and goals. This video is stored locally on your device as a personal commitment and is never uploaded or shared.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: We need microphone access to capture the sound and voice for your one-time future-self video recording and meditations.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: This allows you to save your recorded manifestation journeys and future-self videos directly to your Photo Library.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: We need permission to add your recorded manifestations to your gallery so you can cherish them forever.

plugins.cameraPermission: We need camera access so you can record a video affirmation (the 'Future Self' feature) where you speak as if you have already achieved your dreams and goals. This video is stored locally on your device as a personal commitment and is never uploaded or shared.
plugins.microphonePermission: Allow Manifestation to access your microphone to record audio for your future message.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Manifestation to access your photos to save your recorded future message.
plugins.savePhotosPermission: Allow Manifestation to save your recorded future message to your gallery.
